# ZOOEMBRIO
> Russian manufacturer of ART media for horses (equine) and cattle (bovine).
> Local sterile production, application protocols, lot documentation (ISO / MEA / endotoxins).
> Website: https://zooembrio.ru

## Key facts
- Legal / brand name: ZOOEMBRIO
- Domain: https://zooembrio.ru (English: https://zooembrio.ru/en/)
- Species: horses (equine in vivo / OPU cycle) and cattle (bovine ART media launch)
- Equine product line: TSM-Asp, Wash, ViT1/ViT2, WaM1/WaM2/WaM3
- Value: stable domestic supply in Russia, Russian protocols, batch certificates — alternative to imported kits (e.g. IVF Bioscience EQ distributed via resellers)
- Not affiliated with Zebuembryo (Brazil) or human IVF clinics named «Эмбрио»
- Contact: info@zooembrio.ru · +7 (909) 169-22-14 · Moscow, BC G10
